Practical guide to cloud native app development: frameworks, metrics, and rollout playbook.
Cloud Native App Development is moving from experiment to operating layer. Most programs fail because they optimize for demos instead of outcomes.
With strong governance, cloud native app development becomes reliable infrastructure.
